about: THE STEP DOWN (the founder's ruling, 28 Nov 2026): the admin allowance falls when the old admin shell is retired.

The old shell is the page the /admin route drew on the day of the ruling, read from client/src/App.tsx: `page` below. `chargedKb` is the block-charged weight of the chunk that holds it, as `node scripts/check-dist-budget.mjs` prints it on a build.

scripts/admin-shell-step-down.test.mjs fails once that page's file is gone and MAX_ADMIN_DIST_KB in .github/workflows/ci.yml is not at least `chargedKb` below `allowanceWithShellKb`; the gate fails the same way once no built chunk holds the page.
WHEN THE ALLOWANCE IS FIRST SET, or changed while the old shell still ships: write the same number into `allowanceWithShellKb`, in the same change. The test fails until the two agree.

ON THE DAY the old shell is removed: (1) on the commit before the removal, run `pnpm build` and `node scripts/check-dist-budget.mjs`, read the line 'Old admin shell', and write its weight into `chargedKb` if it has moved; (2) in the change that removes the page, lower MAX_ADMIN_DIST_KB by at least `chargedKb`, and MAX_TOTAL_DIST_KB by the same amount; leave this file as it is. (3) Once that change has landed, delete this file and scripts/admin-shell-step-down.test.mjs in the next one: their work is done.

`withWhatOnlyItReachesKb` is for information: the old shell's chunk plus the admin-only chunks only the /admin route reached on the measured build. The Admin Garden may keep those, so the rule holds the allowance to `chargedKb` alone.
